articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 10:16am on Monday, 10 August 2026, and will remain unavailable until further notice.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the Manchester-bound platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. Those travelling away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street and must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption and advises customers to plan their journeys accordingly.

Further information will be provided as it becomes available.
